links.comparator_used: Informal patient-language prompts versus structured clinical prompts for the same 16 ENT vignettes
links.outcome: Reviewer-rated quality of referral recommendations (appropriateness, clarity, safety, usefulness)
links.effect: Performance declined for one of the two models with informal-language prompts; no numeric values reported in the abstract. Both models gave safe, appropriate recommendations with structured clinical input.
links.quote: Performance declined for one model when prompts were presented in informal language, underscoring the importance of clear input structure.
